items.source: Neither a Callable nor a DeferredResult will complete processing all the way since a MockHttpServletRequest does not perform asynchronous dispatches.
items.translation: 既不是 `Callable` 也不是 `DeferredResult` 会完成全部处理，因为 `MockHttpServletRequest` 不执行异步分发。

items.source: The test will await the completion of a Callable so that the asynchronous result is available and can be further asserted.
items.translation: 该测试将等待 `Callable` 完成，以便异步结果可用并可进行进一步断言。

items.source: Verify whether asynchronous processing has started, usually as a result of a controller method returning a Callable or DeferredResult.
items.translation: 验证是否已启动异步处理，通常这是由于控制器方法返回了 `Callable` 或 `DeferredResult` 的结果。

items.source: ACTUAL - the type of the object to assert
started - whether asynchronous processing should have started
items.translation: started - 异步处理是否应该已开始

items.source: Base AssertJ assertions that can be applied to an HttpServletRequest.
items.translation: 适用于HttpServletRequest的 Base AssertJ 断言。

items.source:
Return a new assertion object that uses the request
attributes as the object to test, with values mapped by attribute name.
items.translation: 返回一个新的断言对象，该对象使用请求属性作为测试对象，并通过属性名映射值。

items.source:
Return a new assertion object that uses the session
attributes as the object to test, with values mapped by attribute name.
items.translation: 返回一个新的断言对象，该对象使用会话属性作为测试对象，并通过属性名映射值。
